props.title: The Founder Fixed the Tests at Ninety-Five Thousand Dollars

props.text: The founding developer pushed two code-quality commits to MiroShark — CI hardening and a test-ordering fix — on the same day the token's FDV broke below $100K for the first time ($95,555).
An automated seller extracts ~$32/hour from the pool while the Aeon agent keeps filing self-improve PRs (now at 91).
Three actors, no coordination, no audience.
